passages.text: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The righteous are people who do what is right.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous people.
The upright are people who are honest and good in heart.
It is right for the upright to praise the LORD.
passages.original: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃

passages.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Praise the LORD.
Use the harp to praise Him.
Make music for the LORD.
Use an instrument with ten strings to make music for Him.
passages.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
passages.sermon: Sing to the LORD a new song.\r\nPlay music well for Him.\r\nShout for joy as you play.
passages.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks words that are upright.
Every word from the LORD is right.
The LORD does all His work with faithfulness.
Every action of the LORD is trustworthy.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־ מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
passages.sermon: The LORD loves righteousness.\r\nThe LORD loves justice.\r\nThe earth is full of the LORD’s loving devotion.
passages.original: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the Creator.
The LORD made the heavens.
He used His word to make the heavens.
The LORD made all the stars.
He used the breath of His mouth to make all the stars.
passages.original: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל־ צְבָאָֽם׃

passages.text: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
He gathers the waters of the sea together.
He piles them up like a heap.
He puts the deep waters into storehouses.
He controls the oceans and the depths.
passages.original: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the one true God.
He created the heavens by His word.
He made all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea.
He stores the depths in storehouses.
All the earth must fear the LORD.
All people who live in the world must revere Him.
passages.original: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃

passages.text: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
He speaks.
What He says happens.
He gives a command.
What He commands stands firm.
passages.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־ צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God over all the earth.
The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations.
The LORD stops the schemes of the peoples.
No nation can succeed against the LORD’s will.
No people can carry out plans that oppose Him.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־ גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives counsel.
His counsel stands forever.
The LORD has purposes in His heart.
His purposes last through all generations.
passages.original: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

passages.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He chooses a people for Himself.
He makes them His inheritance.
A nation is blessed when the LORD is its God.
The people He chooses are truly blessed.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם׀ בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is in heaven.
The LORD looks down from heaven.
The LORD sees every person on earth.
The LORD sees all people.
passages.original: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD lives in heaven.
He has a dwelling place above the earth.
He looks out from His dwelling place.
He watches every person who lives on the earth.
He sees all who inhabit the world.
passages.original: מִֽמְּכוֹן־ שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shapes the hearts of all people.
He understands every person.
He sees everything they do.
He knows all their actions.
passages.original: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־ כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
passages.sermon:
A king cannot save himself with a large army.
A warrior cannot escape by using great strength.
Armies do not guarantee victory.
Strength does not guarantee rescue.
passages.original: אֵֽין־ הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב־ חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא־ יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב־ כֹּֽחַ׃

passages.text: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
passages.sermon:
A horse cannot save anyone.
A horse is not a true hope for rescue.
A horse may be strong.
Its great strength cannot deliver a person.
Trusting in a horse for salvation is useless.
passages.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃

passages.text: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
passages.sermon:
The LORD watches over certain people.
He watches over those who fear Him.
He watches over those who hope in His loving devotion.
He does this to save their lives from death.
He also keeps them alive during famine.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל־ יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃ לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃

passages.text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David pretended to be insane before Abimelech.
Abimelech drove David away.
We wait for the LORD.
We trust the LORD.
The LORD helps us.
The LORD protects us.
The LORD is our shield.
passages.original: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
passages.sermon:
God is holy.
We trust in God's holy name.
Our hearts rejoice in God.
We rejoice because we trust Him.
passages.original: כִּי־ ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He shows loving devotion.
We ask the LORD to let His loving devotion rest on us.
We put our hope in the LORD.
We trust Him.
We wait for Him.
We depend on His kindness.
passages.original: יְהִֽי־ חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
